messages:
alex: Heads up — since the kernel-selection rollout (runtime v2.3.0) we're seeing host-side p99 decode latency up ~20% on small-write traffic. Root traces point at HTTP/2 header coalescing + KV cache churn.

maria: saw this in canary earlier, left a note. evictions on kvcache jumped on hosts with minibatch_size==4. :eyes:

chen: perf top snippet I grabbed from a repro host: 

```
$ perf top -p 23456
 12.3%  libgrpc.so          grpc_chttp2_transport_parse
  9.8%  runtime.so          kernel_selector_mismatch
  6.6%  runtime.so          kvcache_evict_entry
  5.1%  libc.so.6           writev
```

alex: interesting — kernel_selector_mismatch implies our binning heuristic picked the slow scalar kernel for short sequences. header coalesce likely changed write sizes.

sam: eBPF stack shows syscall__writev -> grpc_frame_builder -> header_coalesce -> writev spikes. pattern matches smallwrite amplification after hpack changes.

rachel: minimal repro: run 50 parallel http2 connections doing many 1-token requests to /v1/generate; p99 jumps in ~3m. added repro script to the thread.

infra-bot: deploybot: rollout runtime v2.3.0 to prod-3 at 2025-03-15T21:02Z

maria: hypothesis: header coalesce reduces per-frame overhead but groups bytes so kernel-binner sees different micro-batch lengths -> more single-token minibatches -> lower KV reuse -> higher eviction rate.

chen: quick checklist to triage:
- revert header_coalesce flag on a canary host
- force kernel selection to previous heuristic (env KERNEL_BIN=legacy)
- emit minibatch size histogram at ingress (sampled)
- collect perf + flamegraph on a warm host

alex: I toggled header_coalesce off locally; p99 dropped back to baseline (+-2%). I'll open a PR with traces and the repro.

sam: also see HTTP/2 keepalive and SETTINGS frames increasing small-write frequency for some SDKs. suspect grpc hpack encoder tweak in 2.3.0.

rachel: set temporary alert: host_ingress.kv_evictions > 5/min => page oncall. will watch prod-3. :rotating_light:

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4021 includes: perf graphs, eBPF stacks, repro script and a non-invasive header_coalesce=false toggle.

maria: plan: rollback header_coalesce flag on prod-3 now, land kernel-binning guard in canary, then run a 2h soak with minibatch histograms.

chen: I'll run perf record + flamegraph on a warmed host tonight and share svg. following that I'll run eBPF heaptrack to confirm kv allocation churn.

alex: note: small snippet of the repro curl loop:

```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do 
  curl -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" --http2 
    -d '{"model":"x-small","prompt":"token"}' https://api.prod/v1/generate >/dev/null &
  sleep 0.01
done
```

sam: ping @maria @alex — I can do the rollback window at 01:00 UTC. prepping playbook. :hammer:

rachel: acknowledged. monitoring dashboards pinned to #eng-runtime. will comment with metric deltas.

alex: thanks — will post perf outputs and a short writeup after perf+eBPF runs.

maria: follow-up action items: 1) rollback header_coalesce on prod-3; 2) add kernel-binning guard; 3) instrument minibatch histograms; 4) validate with 2h soak.

chen: adding: investigate grpc hpack delta for small frames; possible remediate by forcing hpack incremental encoder flags.

alex: cc @sam — please coordinate the rollback and keep prod-3 isolated until kernel-bin guard lands.

sam: SG, will update this thread when rollback starts and when metrics stabilize.

rachel: last check-in: prod-3 p95 stable but p99 still trending — will flag if crossing threshold.
